title: TMC-LewisGen: Automated Generation of Lewis-like Structures for Transition–Metal Complexes
description:
Software for TMC-LewisGen: Automated Generation of Lewis-like Structures for Transition–Metal Complexes (https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.6c02278).

This version adds the CBC-informed TMC-BE electron matrix to the command-line engine and Streamlit app, and only promotes chelating oxygen across a carbon-only backbone.
